content:
marie: quick sync 1: are we green to start the ingestion canary on 05/09? need final owner confirmations and any leftover infra risks
akshay: procurement update 1: crates arrived yesterday. rack power activation pending PDUs. vendor timeline ~48h, i've asked for circuit IDs and activation window
sofia: i can be canary lead and run validation. will own smoke run and perf sampling
jin: @akshay when you have circuit IDs drop them here. networking needs VLAN + IPAM before we touch node groups
akshay: provisional circuits: `CIR-312A`, `CIR-312B`. vendor ETA 3245612000 (tomorrow afternoon) - still provisional
sofia: noted, adding provisional to checklist: inventory -> racked -> network -> k8s -> canary
marie: terraform CR for vlan/ipam still open. @jin can you pick review? MR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/+/merge-requests/112
jin: on it. one required change: set `enable_pod_eni = true` on nodegroup to keep pod ips for ingestion tests. leaving comment on MR
sofia: validation targets i'll run: 1000 short docs ingest, p95 < 220ms, error rate < 0.5%. also monitor kv cache warm-up and memory churn on first pass
akshay: ops note: will set nodes to 80% thermal headroom and disable turbo for first 48h to avoid throttling; i'll add BIOS profile to node provisioning
marie: ownership summary: sofia = canary lead, akshay = infra lead, jin = network/k8s, marie = release coord. adding @deploy-bot to schedule nightly smoke for 3 nights post-rollout
deploy-bot: scheduled `canary-nightly-smoke` for 05/09 03:00 UTC. results will be posted to #canary-results
sofia: small ask 1: we need reservation pinning so cluster autoscaler doesn't evict canary nodes during smoke. can we taint/taunt accordingly?
jin: yes - will add `podPriority: high` and label `node.kubernetes.io/canary-reserved=true` in manifest. also a tiny terraform patch for the taint rule in the nodepool
akshay: if PDUs activate as planned, racking -> network -> firmware checks finish by 3245617000. leaving buffer for BIOS + firmware updates
marie: current blockers = terraform CR, VLAN/IPAM allocation, PDU activation. anything else? :thinking_face:
sofia: code review for the ingest job has one flaky auth mock test. i'll triage today and aim to fix by EOD
marie: plan: if all items resolved by EOD tomorrow we kick off canary 05/09. i'll post a 12h countdown and a short rollback plan in this thread. thanks everyone :rocket:
jin: i'll merge the terraform after minor tweaks. ping here once PDUs show live and i'll trigger ipam changes
akshay: will update thread with vendor confirmation and final activation timestamp
sofia: copying the validation checklist snippet here for convenience:
```
- smoke_count: 1000
- p95_latency_target_ms: 220
- error_rate_target_pct: 0.5
- kv_warmup_epochs: 3
- snapshot_resources_before_after: true
```
marie: copied. closing loop for now 1: reopen if anything else surfaces. thanks :thumbsup:
